person.persName: أحمد الشهاب بن الشريفة القدسي ثم المكي وهو ابن محمد بن محمد بن المولى

event.note: al-Qudsī then al-Makkī: originally of Jerusalem, later settled in Mecca (implied by the nisbah sequence and his place of death).

state.label: يتكسب بالكتب
yatakassab bi-l-kutub
state.note: Earned his living dealing in books and other goods (bookseller).

event.note: Had a talent for poetry and the like, and used it to praise our shaykh (Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī) and others.

person.note: アフマド・アッ＝シハーブ・イブン・アッ＝シャリーファ、アル＝クドスィー（エルサレム出身）、後にアル＝マッキー（メッカ定住）。彼はムハンマド・イブン・ムハンマド・イブン・アル＝マウラーの子孫である。書物などの商いで生計を立て、詩作などに才があり、我らがシャイフ（イブン・ハジャル）などを称賛した。873年ズー・アル＝ヒッジャ月にメッカで没した。

Aḥmad al-Shihāb b. al-Sharīfa, al-Qudsī then al-Makkī. He was the son of Muḥammad b. Muḥammad b. al-Mawlā. He earned his living dealing in books and other goods, and had a talent for poetry and the like, with which he praised our shaykh (Ibn Ḥajar) and others. He died in Mecca in Dhū al-Ḥijja 873 H.
